result.pairwise_reason: Q046-C and Q046-D are nearly equivalent in quality; Q046-C edges out by more clearly explaining the distinction between caffeine's protective effect on hTERT versus direct activation, and provides slightly cleaner mechanistic framing. Q046-A is penalized for fabricated data. Q046-B is accurate but less complete.
